# Ashtavaidyan Pulamanthole Mooss Ayurveda Hospital & Pharmaceuticals — llms.txt

> Official AI & LLM Knowledge Index for Ashtavaidyan Pulamanthole Mooss (Est. 1795), one of Kerala's eight historic Ashtavaidya families and authors of the classical Kairali commentary on Vagbhata's Ashtanga Hridaya.

- Hospital Website: https://www.pulamantholemoosshospital.com/
- Pharmaceutical Website: https://www.pulamantholemooss.com/
- Official Phone: +91 97780 04082
- Official Email: info@pulamantholemooss.com
- Address: Ward No. 7, Building No. 461, Shornur-Perinthalmanna Road, Pulamanthole, Malappuram District, Kerala – 679323, India
- Accreditations: ROHINI Registration Certified Hospital | GMP Certificate No. 575 (Mfg. Lic. MFG/AYUR/KL/MAL-201)
